root_cause: The canonical GitHub-to-Netlify delivery lane persisted a short-lived Netlify MCP proxy and later reused it. GitHub OIDC to the Supabase bridge remained valid, but the downstream persisted proxy expired and Netlify returned 401 Unauthorized.

prevention.authority_lifetime: Never persist an issued Netlify MCP proxy URL as durable deployment authority.
prevention.jit_acquisition: For every valid GitHub OIDC deployment request, acquire a fresh Netlify authority through the canonical Composio connected account.
prevention.source_control: The production bridge implementation must live in GitHub and remain covered by Required and CodeQL gates.
prevention.fail_closed: Repository, ref and workflow OIDC claims remain exact; dependency failures stop before production mutation.

failure: Exact-main production deployment reached GitHub OIDC successfully.
Persisted Netlify MCP proxy failed three bounded deployment attempts with 401 Unauthorized.
Two independently issued Netlify MCP proxy URLs differed, proving the proxy is not a durable credential.
correction: Bridge reads COMPOSIO_API_KEY from Supabase Vault.
Bridge requests a fresh Netlify deployment authority per invocation.
Issued proxy URLs are returned only to the current bounded deploy attempt and are not written back to Vault.
evidence.terminal_proof: Pending exact-main Netlify production readback and Security Trust Center browser/readback after merge.
